mapper.insert: INSERT INTO members_rel_tags (tag_id, company_id, user_id) VALUES (#{tagId}, #{companyId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT reltag.user_id AS userId, tag.tag_id AS tagId, tag.tag_name AS tagName, tag.category_id AS categoryId, tag.description AS description, tag.tag_color AS tagColor, tag.font_color AS fontColor FROM members_rel_tags reltag LEFT JOIN members_tags tag ON reltag.tag_id = tag.tag_id WHERE tag.company_id = #{companyId} AND user_id = #{userId}
